```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(here, dplyr, knitr, kableExtra, scales, dampack,
               flexsurv, survival)

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/03_biomarker_strategies.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/06_parametric_survival_analysis.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/07_basecase_input_parameters.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/functions/model_fun.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/functions/calculate_outcomes.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/functions/multi_model_cea.R"))
}))

format_eur <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x) | !is.finite(x), "--",
         scales::dollar(x, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1))
}

format_icer <- function(x, status) {
  if (status %in% c("D", "ED", "Dominated")) return("Dominated")
  if (is.na(x) || !is.finite(x)) return("--")
  scales::dollar(x, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1)
}
```

```{r build-table, include=FALSE}
basecase <- run_basecase(verbose = FALSE)
icer_df <- as.data.frame(basecase$icer_obj)

strategy_labels <- c(
  control = "Standard care",
  crp = "CRP-guided",
  tmb_braf = "TMB/BRAF-guided"
)

display_df <- icer_df %>%
  filter(Strategy %in% names(strategy_labels)) %>%
  mutate(
    Strategy_Label = strategy_labels[Strategy],
    Cost = format_eur(Cost),
    QALYs = sprintf("%.2f", Effect),
    Inc_Cost = format_eur(Inc_Cost),
    Inc_QALYs = ifelse(is.na(Inc_Effect), "--", sprintf("%.2f", Inc_Effect)),
    ICER = mapply(format_icer, ICER, Status)
  ) %>%
  select(Strategy_Label, Cost, QALYs, Inc_Cost, Inc_QALYs, ICER)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(
  display_df,
  caption = "Table 4: Base-case cost-effectiveness results, overall MSS population",
  format = "html",
  col.names = c("Strategy", "Cost", "QALYs", "Incremental Cost",
                "Incremental QALYs", "ICER"),
  align = c("l", rep("r", 5))
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Costs and QALYs discounted at 4% per year.",
      "ICER = incremental cost-effectiveness ratio versus the next non-dominated alternative.",
      paste0("WTP threshold: EUR ", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), "/QALY.")
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(icer_df, file = here("tables", "table_4.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Table 4 has been saved to `tables/table_4.csv`.
